faqs.question: Can Roman numerals be negative or zero?
faqs.answer: Classical Roman numerals do not have symbols for zero or negative numbers. Results of 0 or negative calculations are represented in Arabic numbers or as 'nulla'.

faqs.question: What is the maximum number this calculator supports?
faqs.answer: Standard classical Roman numerals support integers up to 3,999 (MMMCMXCIX).
